pick_implementation.title: Pick your xCREAS authorization
pick_implementation.description: Sign in to xCREAS in the browser window and choose the devices Home Assistant may control.

auth.title: Connect to xCREAS
auth.description: The xCREAS authorization was not completed. Open the link again and select your devices.

error.invalid_token: The xCREAS authorization expired. Start again.
error.insufficient_scope: The authorization is missing the required scope. Start again.
error.device_not_authorized: A selected device is no longer accessible from your account. Check the device in the xCREAS app.
error.device_not_found: A selected device no longer exists.
error.device_offline: A selected device is currently offline.
error.device_unavailable: The device state could not be read from the xCREAS cloud.
error.device_not_active: A selected device is not active.
error.state_unavailable: The device state could not be read.
error.device_access_unavailable: The device access check failed on the xCREAS cloud.
error.service_unavailable: The xCREAS service is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
error.transport_error: Could not reach the xCREAS cloud. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Please check the logs and try again.

abort.already_configured: This xCREAS account is already set up.
abort.oauth_error: The xCREAS authorization was cancelled or failed.
abort.missing_configuration: The integration is missing its OAuth configuration.
abort.no_devices_authorized: No devices were authorized for this connection. Reconnect and select at least one device on the xCREAS page.
abort.device_already_linked: One of the selected devices is already controlled by another xCREAS connection in this Home Assistant. Revoke that connection first (xCREAS app → Integrations → Home Assistant).
abort.account_unresolved: The xCREAS cloud did not identify the account.
